evidence.note: Dark folding chair is compactly folded in the corner near the room entrance.
Chair fabric and frame fill the view while the chair is being expanded.
Chair is clearly standing open with its seat, back, arms, and legs deployed.
Chair remains open immediately before the closing transition.
Chair is again compactly folded in its original corner.

events.object_description: Dark green/black folding camp chair in the entrance-side corner of the long wall

evidence.note: Second dark folding chair is collapsed in the corner beside the window and desk.
Expanded fabric fills the view during deployment.
Chair is visibly open and standing beside the desk.
Chair remains deployed just before it is closed.
Chair is folded back into a compact bundle in the window-side corner.

events.object_description: Dark green/black folding camp chair in the window-side corner beside the desk

evidence.note: Blue folding chair is collapsed in the corner near the window and head of the bed.
Close-up expanded blue fabric indicates the chair is being opened.
Blue chair is clearly deployed and standing.
Chair remains fully open shortly before closing.
Blurred partial chair and abrupt viewpoint change indicate active folding.
Blue chair is compactly folded in the corner again.

events.object_description: Blue folding camp chair near the window and headboard

notes: Three distinct localized chair-manipulation episodes are visible. Midpoints were estimated across the sampled transition intervals; the initial and final room traversals were not counted.
scene_description: A bedroom containing a bed, standing desk, and three folding camp chairs stored in separate corners. The camera surveys the room, then approaches each chair consecutively to unfold it, observe it while open, and fold it again.
